description.value:
Duration permanent

You learn your bound spirit's true name. Your Fraying die drops one step permanently while that spirit is the one bound to you — this stacks with the improvement at 7th level. The spirit may still refuse an ask, but it can no longer feign ignorance of you: it may never make you repeat, rephrase, or re-establish who you are, and effects that would sever or confuse your bond take a status penalty against you.
